description:
Welcome to my channel FloridaBoy Survival.  
This is my channel dedicated to showing you the challenges that we have to survive in the woods of Central Florida.  We have snakes, deer, wild hogs, panthers, raccoons, opossums, mosquitos, and the occasional black bear to contend with.  Central Florida is a wonderful place if you can learn the tricks of the swamp.  I am a life long resident and have been tromping around in these swamps since I was a kid.  Come along with me and see some of the beautiful and possibly dangerous places that Florida has to offer.
